grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，或称为'过去的过去' 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时

examples.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets, we stopped at a square.
examples.zh: 因为我们穿过市场走了很长一段路，所以我们在广场上停下来。

examples.en: He had opened one of the baskets before we approached.
examples.zh: 在我们走近之前，他已经打开了其中一个篮子。

grammar.title: As soon as 引导的时间状语从句
grammar.structure: As soon as + 主语 + 动词过去式, 主语 + 动词过去式
grammar.definition: 表示'一...就...'，强调两个紧接着发生的动作 从句动作发生后，主句动作紧接着发生，从句用一般过去时

examples.en: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe.
examples.zh: 他一看到我们，就拿起一根长笛。

examples.en: As soon as he began to play a tune, the snake rose out of the basket.
examples.zh: 他一吹奏曲子，蛇就从篮子里升起来。

grammar.title: could表示能力
grammar.structure: 主语 + could/could not + 动词原形
grammar.definition: could是can的过去式，表示过去的能力或可能性 描述过去的能力或表示委婉的可能性否定形式could not表示不能

examples.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz.
examples.zh: 它显然无法区分印度音乐和爵士乐。

examples.en: The child could not understand what happened.
examples.zh: 那个孩子无法理解发生了什么。

lines.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi, we stopped at a square to have a rest.
lines.zh: 当我们穿过旧德里的市场时走了很长一段路，我们在一个广场上停下来休息。

lines.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square, so we went to have a look at him.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的那一边有一个带着两个大筐的耍蛇人，于是就走过去看看。

lines.en: As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
lines.zh: 他一见我们，就拿起了一个长长的上面镶有硬币的管乐器，并掀开了一个筐的盖子。

lines.en: When he began to play a tune , we had our first glimpse of the snake.
lines.zh: 当他开始吹奏一支曲子时，我们才第一次看到那条蛇。

lines.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
lines.zh: 它从筐里探出身子，随着乐器的摆动而扭动。

lines.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
lines.zh: 当耍蛇人突然又吹奏起爵士乐和现代流行乐曲时，我们感到非常惊奇。

lines.en: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
lines.zh: 然而那蛇却还是缓慢地“舞动”着。

lines.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
lines.zh: 显然，它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐！

questions.q: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
questions.zh: 当耍蛇人开始吹奏爵士乐时，发生了什么事？
questions.a: The snake continued to 'dance' slowly. It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
questions.aZh: 那条蛇依旧缓慢地“舞动”着，显然它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐！

questions.q: Where did they stop to have a rest, and what did they notice after a time?
questions.zh: 他们在哪里停下来休息？过了一会儿又注意到了什么？
questions.a: They stopped at a square and noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square.
questions.aZh: 他们在一个广场上停下来休息，随后注意到广场另一边有个带着两个大筐的耍蛇人。

questions.q: What did the snake do when the snake charmer began to play a tune?
questions.zh: 耍蛇人开始吹奏曲子时，蛇做了什么？
questions.a: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
questions.aZh: 它从筐里探出身子，随着管子的摆动而扭动。

questions.q: Why were they very much surprised?
questions.zh: 他们为什么感到非常惊奇？
questions.a: Because the snake charmer suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
questions.aZh: 因为耍蛇人突然吹奏起爵士乐和现代流行歌曲。

questions.q: Why is the lesson called 'Not very musical'? Who is really not musical?
questions.zh: 课文为什么叫“并非很懂音乐”？到底是谁不懂音乐？
questions.a: It is the snake, not the man: it went on 'dancing' to jazz and pop exactly as it had to Indian music, so it was the one with no ear for music.
questions.aZh: 指的不是耍蛇人，而是那条蛇：它跟着爵士乐和流行曲照旧慢舞，所以它才是“不懂音乐”的那个。

translation:
当我们穿过旧德里的市场时走了很长一段路，我们在一个广场上停下来休息。
过了一会儿，我们注意到广场的那一边有一个带着两个大筐的耍蛇人，于是就走过去看看。
他一见我们，就拿起了一个长长的上面镶有硬币的管乐器，并掀开了一个筐的盖子。
当他开始吹奏一支曲子时，我们才第一次看到那条蛇。
它从筐里探出身子，随着乐器的摆动而扭动。
当耍蛇人突然又吹奏起爵士乐和现代流行乐曲时，我们感到非常惊奇。
然而那蛇却还是缓慢地“舞动”着。
显然，它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐！
title: Not very musical
subtitle: 并非很懂音乐

lead.question: 耍蛇人吹起爵士乐后，那条蛇为什么还在慢悠悠地“舞动”？
lead.warmup: 想象你在旧德里的集市里走了很久，正坐在广场上歇脚。广场对面，一个耍蛇人掀开竹筐，吹起镶满硬币的长管，一条蛇应声而起，随管子的摆动扭动身子。可当曲子换成爵士乐和流行歌时，蛇依旧慢悠悠地“舞动”。读完这一课你会发现：真正“不太懂音乐”的，其实不是耍蛇人。
goals: 准确理解并运用 musical、market、snake charmer、pipe、tune、glimpse、movement、obviously、difference 等核心词汇
熟练掌握 play a tune、have a glimpse of、tell the difference between、pick up 等短语
掌握“have + 名词”代替普通动词的表达（have a rest / have a look / have a glimpse）
辨析 stop to do 与 stop doing、continue to do 与 continue doing
lead.summary: 作者一行穿过旧德里的一个集市，走得疲惫后在广场歇脚，随即被对面的耍蛇人吸引：他拿起镶满硬币的长管吹奏曲子，蛇从筐中探身，随管子的摆动作舞。曲风突变为爵士乐与现代流行歌曲，蛇却照旧慢舞不止——它根本分不清印度音乐与爵士乐。
lead.tips: 易错点：stop to do 是“停下来去做另一件事”，stop doing 才是“停止正在做的事”；glimpse 固定搭配 have/catch/get a glimpse of。

exercises.q: 填空：As soon as he saw us, he picked up a long ___ which was covered with coins and opened one of the ___.
用“have + 名词”改写：They looked at the snake charmer for a moment.
exercises.a: They had a look at the snake charmer.
exercises.note: have a look at = look at。

exercises.q: 就划线部分提问：We had our first glimpse of the snake when he began to play a tune.（对 when 从句提问）
exercises.a: When did you have your first glimpse of the snake?

exercises.q: 汉译英：显然，它分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐！
exercises.a: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
exercises.note: tell 与 can/could 连用表辨别。

exercises.q: 用“have + 名词”改写：I swam in the river yesterday morning.
exercises.a: I had a swim in the river yesterday morning.
exercises.note: have + 名词代替普通动词。

exercises.q: 填空：The snake continued ___ (dance) slowly; it ___ (rise) out of the basket a moment earlier.
exercises.note: 过去完成时表先于过去的动作。

exercises.q: 标题 Not very musical 中的 musical 指谁？用一句英文回答。
exercises.a: It refers to the snake, which could not tell Indian music from jazz.

quiz.q: 课文中的耍蛇人拿起的是一件什么样的乐器？
options: A long pipe which was covered with coins
A short flute made of bamboo
A violin with two strings
A drum full of coins
quiz.note: 第 3 句：pick up a long pipe。

quiz.q: 作者一行在什么地方走了很长一段路？
options: Along the streets of new Delhi
Through one of the markets of old Delhi
Around a square in old Delhi
Inside the snake charmer's house

quiz.q: “we stopped at a square to have a rest”中 stop 的用法是哪一项？
options: It means they gave up resting
It means they rested while walking
It means they stopped walking in order to rest
It means they had already rested
quiz.note: stop to do 表停下原动作去做。

quiz.q: 文中 “After a time” 的含义最接近哪一项？
options: In time
On time
At times
After a while
quiz.note: after a time = 过了一会儿。

quiz.q: have a glimpse of 的同义表达是哪一个？
options: catch a brief look at
stare at for a long time
look for something carefully
watch something slowly move

quiz.q: 课文最后一句说，那条蛇显然做不到什么？
options: dance to the movements of the pipe
rise out of the basket again
tell the difference between Indian music and jazz
follow the snake charmer home
